area.howToPlan: The person confirmed this outline. To survey it, give plan_create placeAreas with the survey pattern's id and “pa0123456789abcdef”, and the survey's area as []. The plan then takes exactly the 4 confirmed corners. The preview shows all 4 corners. Never plan from the preview.
